o1: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity and MAP kinase kinase kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including p38MAPK cascade; regulation of axon extension; sprouting of injured axon; axon regeneration; and neuron remodeling. Is located in neuronal cell body and synapse. Is expressed in neurons (including the PLM neuron) and pharynx. Is part of the MAP kinase signaling pathway. Orthologous to several human genes, including MAP3K12 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 12).
